content:
Ava (Finance): Heads up — AWS Marketplace invoice for March (INV-2028-03-MP-009) shows both the new product codes AND legacy SKU line items for several reseller customers. Looks like duplicate charges.
Leo (Finance Ops): Ugh. Can you paste the invoice PDF or a quick excerpt of the lines?
Ava (Finance): Attached the export snippet below. Key customer is AcmeCorp, reseller channel. Lines: 
```
line 42: legacy-sku-ALPHA-001 qty 1 $2,500
line 43: new-code-RWINF-ALPHA qty 1 $2,500
```
Maya (Revenue Ops): We switched mapping to new-code-RWINF-* on 2028-01-15. Partner onboarding sheet had a migration note but I thought it applied to all channels.
Jesse (Partner Ops): FYI the mapping table in PartnerDB was updated, but the CloudChannel export job that feeds marketplace manifest wasn't. I flagged a deploy in Jan but it reverted during the pipeline rollback.
Nina (FP&A): Do we have count of impacted customers or $ exposure? Need to estimate credit reserve.
Ava (Finance): Quick grep says ~6 invoices with duplicate lines, total exposure ~$18,300. Most are under $5k except AcmeCorp at $7,500.
billing-bot: Automated alert: invoice INV-2028-03-MP-009 posted to ledger at 2028-03-04T08:12:33Z.
Leo (Finance Ops): I'll open a case with AWS Marketplace support — we should confirm whether charges clear on their end or if they can void the duplicates. Tagging @Jesse for mapping fix.
Jesse (Partner Ops): On it. Plan: 1) apply corrected export mapping to CloudChannel job; 2) re-generate marketplace manifests for affected resellers; 3) create credit memos for duplicate lines. I can run a dry-run SQL to identify impacted subscriptions: `SELECT account_id, invoice_id, SUM(amount) FROM marketplace_invoice_lines WHERE sku LIKE 'legacy-%' AND invoice_date >= '2028-03-01' GROUP BY account_id, invoice_id;`
Maya (Revenue Ops): If credits < $5k, we can auto-approve. Anything > $5k needs Ava + Nina approval for reserve release.
Nina (FP&A): Agreed. Please tag me when you have the list. I'll provision reserve if numbers match.
Ava (Finance): Approve credits up to $5k. For AcmeCorp ($7.5k) hold until we confirm AWS can void the duplicate or we issue a credit memo.
Leo (Finance Ops): AWS case opened: case 1234567890. Customer-facing note drafted — awaiting AWS response.
Jesse (Partner Ops): Mapping patch scheduled in staging now, will promote to prod after smoke tests. I will also generate the CSV of impacted invoices and upload to the shared sheet.
Ava (Finance): Drop the sheet link here when done. I'll prepare the credit memos template.
Jesse (Partner Ops): Uploaded: https://redwood.app/sheets/marketplace-mapping-2028 — sheet "duplicates-2028-03". Columns: account_id, invoice_id, legacy_sku_line, new_code_line, amount, suggested_action.
Leo (Finance Ops): Thx. Action items: @Jesse run mapping fix + CSV; @Leo follow up AWS case; @Ava prepare credit memos; @Nina provision reserve for >$5k once validated.
Maya (Revenue Ops): Also check partner statements for Feb/March reconciliation — some partners may have reconciled on legacy SKUs already. We should coordinate messaging.
Ava (Finance): I'll draft a short partner note after we confirm the fix — keep it factual: cause, impact, next steps, ETA.
Nina (FP&A): ETA for fix?
Jesse (Partner Ops): Prod deploy ETA 2 hours; CSV ready in ~30 mins.
Leo (Finance Ops): Noted. Marking this P1 for finance until credits issued. :warning:
Ava (Finance): Thanks everyone — let's sync on this thread with updates. :thumbsup:
